text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 22, 2023) for 32 Maynard Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 22, 2023) for 32 Maynard Avenue, Folder Number: 23 190448 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to November 20, 2024.
